findings.title: Shipping zone is uppercased inline instead of in the domain model
findings.body: The new field `shipping_zone` is uppercased inline, while the existing code in this file (line 26) accesses `order.shipping_address.city` without transformation. This inconsistency breaks the local convention that transformations happen in the domain model or a dedicated helper, not inline in the confirmation logic. Move the uppercasing to the domain model or a helper function used by both lines.

summary.problem: The confirmation response uppercases the shipping zone inline, inconsistent with the rest of the file.
summary.done_well: The change adds a new field to the confirmation response and keeps the existing logic intact.
